cohort: 950 women who gave birth in the Department of Obstetrics and Perinatology of the University Hospital in Kraków for six months (between 1st January and 30th June 2018)
finding: Advanced maternal age was associated with an increased risk of preterm birth, caesarean section, large for gestational age (LGA), and postpartum haemorrhage.
mod_finding: Advanced maternal age was found to be a predisposing factor for preterm birth, cesarean section, and large for gestational age.
